title: No-Show Penalty Figures Carried by the Hotel Rate Plans
content:
A guest who never arrives is dealt with under the no-show figures of the Hotel Rate Plans. Each plan records two of them, one expressed in room nights and one expressed as a share of the room total.

| Rate plan | No-show penalty, room nights | No-show penalty, percent of the room total |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0 | 100 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 1 | 100 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 1 | 50 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 1 | 25 |
| Member Flex Rate | 1 | 25 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 2 | 50 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 3 | 100 |

**Room nights** are the nights withheld when the guest never arrives. **Percent of the room total** is the share withheld where the penalty is expressed as a share.

Three plans record 100 percent: the Non-Refundable Saver Rate, the Advance Purchase 21 Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate. The Standard Flexible Rate and the Member Flex Rate record the lightest share at 25 percent. Only the Non-Refundable Saver Rate records 0 room nights, and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate records the most at 3.
